cause: A Linux extensionless ELF binary was mistakenly passed directly to Windows PowerShell, which invoked the Windows Open With association chooser instead of executing it.
user_visible_effect: Parent reported Windows Open With chooser for crane.
subsequent_probe: Filtered Win32_Process query for OpenWith.exe returned no processes.
termination: No shared UI or unrelated process was terminated.
prevention: Windows commands must use crane.exe; Linux crane is invoked only inside docker run/exec. All final RC probes use the Linux container.
